scope: Source-bound implementation and local development tests; separate toolchain and CLI scopes, no fresh benchmark or signed independent replay.
statement: Source 5e3a4202 implements three IC comparison arms: special auxiliary maps, direct search on exactly the special base, and ordinary random equal-column subgroup bases. Fixed-prefix relation-yield mode processes matching public walks without early recovery; full solve mode retains graph/certificate recovery. Stable and Rust 1.78 core suites each pass 25 checks including a doctest, and six targeted CLI checks plus strict lint/format/docs controls pass on the pinned source. The 61-bit random control clears the Hasse-certified cofactor rather than relying on rare subgroup rejection. Source 76a941c2 adds a hosted CLI comparison job without removing prior checks; hosted results are not yet established. The snapshot remains unchanged. This is unsigned development correctness, not an observed random-versus-auxiliary timing advantage.
